findings.evidence: template/scripts/publication_queue.py:604 now calls _admission_handoff even when an exact-head requirement-composition identity already exists and require_composition_finalized has succeeded. _admission_handoff rejects compositions without .managed-task-state.json at lines 531–532, or rejects a coordinator checkout at another head at lines 536–537. The existing final-publication path in template/scripts/requirement_composition.py:368 records the validated composition identity, then calls adapter.admit(root, number, head) without a handoff at line 375, after closing its disposable exact-head checkout. A read-only mocked reproduction with a composition identity and no single-task state raises: 'managed candidate requirement/BR-415 lacks valid exact task-content provenance: the head changes an OpenSpec change but the checkout has no managed task state'. This blocks terminal delivery of otherwise validated multi-child Requirements.
findings.summary: Final Requirement compositions can no longer enter the publication queue because admission unconditionally requires single-task checkout provenance.
